    The T_Λ anchored families #

    Over an infinite field, distinct subsets X_j ⊆ k give pairwise orthogonal bricks T_{Λ_{X_j}}, orthogonal to the anchor T_{Λ₀}, with explicit non-split classes (KroneckerBricks/Medium.lean, KroneckerBricks/NonSplit.lean). This is an anchored family over any index type J with J ↪ Set k (Bricks.lamAnchored); for J countable it is the ω-seed used to transport rigid R_ω-structures.
